name: build_scene_collision_context
summary: Build partial observed surface occupancy from registered depth and synchronized public robot geometry.

generality.rationale: Object-independent measured surfaces across tasks; restricted to undistorted registered pinhole RGB-D and supported serial-chain robot models.
assumptions: Stationary synchronized acquisition, valid calibration and explicit sensor error budget.
limitations: Partial surface occupancy; unseen space and object interiors remain unknown.
Conservative arm filtering can remove nearby object points; grippers and fixed chassis are unmodeled.
No semantic object reconstruction or free-space certification.
tested_tasks: Synthetic calibrated depth, invalid pixels, voxel and synchronized robot-filter regression fixtures
Recorded turn-switch 320x240 PGM projection and voxel smoke: 76800 returns, 2456 occupied surface cells; full synchronized real-camera robot-filter test remains pending

level.rationale: Compose calibrated depth reconstruction, robot geometry filtering and occupied voxel context construction.

composition.strategy: Use public link FK bounds to filter measured robot returns; voxelize remaining observed world surfaces and retain provenance and unknown coverage.

provenance.failure_gap: Known-obstacle checks lack automatic measured scene coverage and cannot detect unmodeled clutter.
evidence: User requested observed environment, self and dual-arm collision support.
